paragraphs: R' Zekharyah ben Avkulas, at the time of the Destruction. See [Gittin 56a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.56a.4-5).[^1][^2]

notes.text: An isolated כ precedes Gittin in the frozen text.

The linked account has Rabbi Zekharyah ben Avkulas object in the bar Kamtza episode. Rabbi Yochanan then gives his assessment of those decisions in connection with the destruction. [Heilprin’s Avkulas entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=203&lang=en) lists Zekharyah as his son.
